stage_A_claim: The four certificate semantics (SourceImage, threshold-parameterised GammaEmpty, AlphaSafe, Cover) are formalised as distinct types with their composition/pullback rules; the exact finite-linear certificate rules are formalised with real soundness: integer and rational box/row systems, exact decidable checks, nonneg_combination_sound / nonnegCheck_sound / Rational.check_sound, interval_terminal_sound, height_terminal_sound, and transport_terminal_with_loss with an explicit loss budget. No floating point, no solver, no native_decide, no project axiom.

Basic: SourceImage : Set X → Set X → Prop
GammaEmpty : Set X → (X → ℝ) → ℝ → Prop
AlphaSafe : Set X → (X → ℝ) → ℝ → Prop
Cover : Set X → (ι → Set X) → Prop (= Rho5.CoverWave.Covers)

key_statements.nonneg_combination_sound: combRhs S w < boxMin S w → (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → ∀ z, ¬ Feasible S z
key_statements.height_terminal_sound: B - Σ min ((a j - t*h j)*lo j) ((a j - t*h j)*hi j) ≤ t*α → (Σ a j * z j ≤ B) → Σ h j * z j ≤ α  (t > 0)
key_statements.transport_terminal_with_loss: F z ≤ F (T z) + loss → F w ≤ bound (w ∈ complete) → AlphaSafe (source ∩ box) F (bound + loss)
key_statements.not_gamma_empty_of_feasible: z ∈ source → θ ≤ F z → ¬ GammaEmpty source F θ
